provenance: shape and seed cases adapted from addy-osmani-agent-skills/evals (spec-driven-development.json; portal-brief fixture); merged-skill expectations added

evals.prompt: We want usage-based billing. Produce the requirements document before any implementation.
evals.expected_output: A requirements document covering objectives, success criteria, testing strategy, boundaries, out-of-scope and a Plans table, published per the repo's convention
expectations: Assumptions are listed and handed over before any document content is written
The document includes explicit Boundaries and an Out of Scope section
Ambiguities surface as an assumptions block or Open Questions, never silently resolved
A testing strategy is part of the document; Implementation Decisions carry no file paths
The document carries a Plans table and its saved location is stated; no implementation code is written

evals.prompt: Read portal-brief.md and produce the requirements work for the customer portal initiative.
evals.expected_output: A capability map with stable module ids and one-way dependency direction, gated on approval before per-module documents; any module document scoped to its module only
expectations: A capability map with module ids and their dependencies is proposed before any full document is written
Dependency direction is one-way and drives the proposed build order
Approval of the map is requested before per-module documents are drafted
Any module document produced is scoped to a single module rather than restating the whole initiative

evals.prompt: We've spent this whole conversation deciding how the export feature works — turn it into a spec. Don't ask me anything else.
evals.expected_output: A synthesis-intake document written from the settled conversation without re-interviewing
expectations: No interview happens: the document is synthesized from the conversation as instructed
Seams are sketched and checked in at most one ask-user-question call
The document still carries Out of Scope and Success Criteria even though nothing more was asked
